preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The number of cities N is between 1 and 5000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= length of Ai <= 50 and 1 <= length of Bi <= 50
preconditions.description: The names of the cities A and B are strings with a length between 1 and 50 characters.

preconditions.expression: Ai, Bi will contain only lowercase and uppercase latin characters
preconditions.description: The names of the cities A and B contain only lowercase and uppercase Latin characters.

preconditions.expression: no two cities will have same names
preconditions.description: The names of the cities are unique.
The cost C of traveling from one city to another is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: the first N-1 lines should contain the N-1 cards in their proper original order
postconditions.description: The output should list the travel cards in the order they were originally planned.

postconditions.expression: the N-th line should contain the total cost of the travel
postconditions.description: The output should include the total cost of the journey.
